question: Can finite native-i transport coherence supply the missing universal cycle-class invariance theorem?

DPC.problem: Functoriality transports cycles but does not supply an identity cell between a cycle and its transform; the current all-cycle class-invariance theorem is missing.
DPC.candidate_conjecture_under_attack: The native finite-order symmetry and cycle-supplied coherence alone force every algebraic cycle to be equivariant, with any failure detected by positive-degree rational C4 coherence.
rivals: Only natural transport is forced; pointwise cycle-object equivariance is false even on the fixed source.
Finite-group additive rational higher-coherence groups vanish, leaving the degree-zero class-invariance problem unchanged.
Additional algebraic-specific class-level necessity may exist but is not supplied by these premises.
risky_consequences: A codimension-three complete intersection through p but not tau(p) must not furnish a tau-equivariant structure sheaf.
The exact C4 cochain contraction must work in both parities for every rational representation tested, with a general all-degrees proof.
Integral torsion controls must disappear after rationalization, without implying alpha itself vanishes.
DPC.falsification_attempt: A source-bound very-ample/Bertini cycle control, exact nonfixed torsion-point orbit, exact rational periodic-resolution contraction, averaging-change and integral-torsion hostiles.
DPC.disposition_rule: Reject only the two stated shortcuts if the proofs hold. Do not reject fixed-X all-cycle invariance or the general higher-coherence conjecture, and do not claim a Hodge counterexample.

imported_geometric_facts: The fixed marked sixfold is smooth projective with algebraic tau=i and tau^4=Id.
Ample line bundles admit very ample powers, and a finite tensor product of very ample line bundles is very ample.
Very ample systems separate points and tangent directions; Bertini over C supplies smooth codimension-three complete intersections through a specified smooth point while avoiding a distinct point.
Pullback preserves cycle classes and rational equivalence; supports distinguish nonisomorphic structure sheaves.
